title: FRANK Workspace Causal Reachability and Delivery Semantics
summary: Second FRANK trigger delta: current GlobalWorkspace is code-grounded as a synchronous broadcast primitive, but active multi-producer reachability and coalition competition are not statically demonstrated. Priority shifts from premature async optimization to causal wiring/selection instrumentation, followed by typed delivery semantics for future slow or side-effect subscribers.
open_questions: Does a representative live FRANK session produce any GlobalWorkspace broadcasts?
Where, if anywhere, does candidate competition/selection occur before publish()?
Which state changes demonstrably depend on a selected workspace event?
Which event classes are non-droppable versus coalescible or best-effort?
What callback p99 budget is justified on the target host?
